user.title: Set up Notes Vault
user.description: Choose the folder, inside the Home Assistant configuration directory, that holds the vault. It's created if it doesn't exist, and it's part of every backup.

data_description.folder: Relative to the configuration directory, for example `notes_vault`. Point it at an existing Obsidian vault to keep using it.

error.invalid_folder: Use a relative folder name without `..`, and not a hidden folder.
error.reserved_folder: Home Assistant uses this folder for something else. Notes under www/ would be public, for example. Pick another one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notes Vault is already set up. There's only one vault.

init.title: Generated notes
init.description: Every entity, device, area and integration can get its own note, so you can link to it from Obsidian. Filters only stop empty notes from being generated: anything you've written a note on keeps its file.

data.exclude_devices: Skip these devices and their entities

data_description.base_folder: Inside the vault. Leave empty to put the Entities, Devices, Areas and Integrations folders at the top level.
data_description.generate_integrations: A note per integration, linking its devices and the entities that have no device, so things without an area aren't left on their own in the graph.
data_description.webdav: Needed for the remotely-save plugin in Obsidian. Clients sign in with a long-lived access token of an administrator.
data_description.include_service_devices: Devices that integrations and add-ons register for themselves (Sun, Backup, add-ons, cloud services). They aren't things in the house, and each integration already has a note. Their entities are linked from the integration's note either way.

error.invalid_folder: Use a relative folder name without `..`.

get_note.name: Get note
get_note.description: Returns the note of an entity, device or area, with the path and wikilink of its file in the vault.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity whose note to use.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device whose note to use.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area whose note to use.

set_note.name: Set note
set_note.description: Replaces, or appends to, the note of an entity, device or area. The generated frontmatter is kept, and a replaced note is kept in the vault's trash for 30 days.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity whose note to use.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device whose note to use.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area whose note to use.

note.name: Note
note.description: Markdown text. Link to other things with wikilinks such as [[light.kitchen]].

append.name: Append
append.description: Add to the end of the existing note instead of replacing it.

read_file.name: Read file
read_file.description: Returns the content of any file in the vault.

path.name: Path
path.description: Relative to the vault, for example `Home Assistant/Entities/light.kitchen.md`.

write_file.name: Write file
write_file.description: Creates or overwrites a file in the vault. Missing folders are created, and an overwritten file is kept in the vault's trash for 30 days.

path.name: Path
path.description: Relative to the vault, for example `Projects/Garden irrigation.md`.

append.name: Append
append.description: Add to the end of the file instead of replacing it.

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Moves a file or folder to the vault's trash, where it stays for 30 days. A generated note comes back, empty, at the next sync.

list_files.name: List files
list_files.description: Lists the files in a folder of the vault.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Relative to the vault. Empty for the top level.

search.name: Search
search.description: Finds notes containing every word of a query, in their path or content.

query.name: Query
query.description: Words to look for. Case doesn't matter.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Re-reads the vault and regenerates the entity, device and area notes now.

get_template.name: Get template
get_template.description: Returns a note template filled in for an entity, device or area. Without a template name, returns the one that fits best.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity to fill the template in for.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device to fill the template in for.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area to fill the template in for.

template.name: Template
template.description: Name of the template file, without .md. Leave empty for the best match.

list_templates.name: List templates
list_templates.description: Lists the note templates in the vault and what each one applies to.

applies_to.name: Applies to
applies_to.description: Only list templates for entities, devices or areas.

not_loaded.message: Notes Vault isn't set up or isn't loaded.

no_target.message: Pass one of entity_id, device_id or area_id.

invalid_path.message: {path} isn't a valid path inside the vault.

locked_folder.message: {path} holds the generated notes and can't be deleted. Change where they go in the integration's options instead.
